body:
Implement Track 2 (Part 1 — orchestrator-handoff.md §3.1, §3.2, §3.3, §3.6):

1. `hooks/policy/paths.mjs`:
   - Expand `boosterDataRoots(home)` to return all 4 canonical plugin-data roots under `home`: `join(home, '.gemini', 'antigravity-cli', 'plugin_data', 'antigravity-booster')`, `join(home, '.gemini', 'antigravity', 'plugin_data', 'antigravity-booster')`, `join(home, '.gemini', 'antigravity-ide', 'plugin_data', 'antigravity-booster')`, and `join(home, '.config', 'antigravity-booster')`.

2. `hooks/policy/constants.mjs`:
   - Add `'list_dir'`, `'list_permissions'`, `'search_in_file'`, `'wait'`, and `'wait_5_seconds'` to `READ_ONLY_TOOLS` (retaining all existing legacy names).
   - Update `READ_TOOL_PATH_SCHEMAS` to include `list_dir`, `list_permissions`, and `search_in_file`.
   - Export `REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS` mapping the 10 required-path read tools to their folded lowercase key arrays:
     - `view_file` & `view_file_outline`: `['absolutepath', 'filepath', 'path']`
     - `read_file`: `['path', 'absolutepath', 'filepath']`
     - `read_notebook`: `['notebookpath', 'absolutepath', 'path']`
     - `read_browser_page` & `read_url_content`: `['url']`
     - `list_dir` & `list_directory`: `['directorypath', 'dirabsolutepath', 'absolutepath', 'path', 'dir']`
     - `list_permissions`: `['paths', 'path']`
     - `search_in_file`: `['paths', 'path', 'directorypath', 'searchpath']`.

3. `hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs`:
   - Export `goFoldKey(k)` = `String(k).replace(/\u017f/g, 's').replace(/\u212a/g, 'k').toLowerCase()`.
   - Export `normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(args)`:
     (a) Reject non-plain objects (`args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)`) with `{ ok: false, reason: 'Tool arguments must be a plain JSON object' }`.
     (b) Enforce pure printable-ASCII key gate first: every key `k` in `Object.keys(args)` must match `/^[\x20-\x7E]+$/`; any non-ASCII rune (including `U+017F` `'ſ'` and `U+212A` `'K'`) or control byte returns `{ ok: false, reason: ... }`.
     (c) Fold keys via `goFoldKey(k)`; if any two keys collide under `goFoldKey`, return `{ ok: false, reason: 'Duplicate case-folded argument key ...' }`. Otherwise return `{ ok: true, folded, raw: args }` where `folded` uses `Object.create(null)`.
   - Enforce `normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(args)` at the top of `stepOne(name, args, ctx)` (so every non-control tool rejects non-plain-object args, non-ASCII keys, and Go-fold duplicate keys across all 5 context columns) and in `extractProbedPaths` (supporting case-folded required/altRequired lookup on `TOOL_PATH_SCHEMAS`). Note: `payload.toolCall.args === undefined` defaults to `{}` before `stepOne`, while explicit `args: null` or `args: []` on `payload.toolCall` must be denied.
   - Export `extractReadToolPaths(name, rawArgs)` and wire into `stepOne`:
     - When `Object.hasOwn(REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS, name)`:
       1. Validate `normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(rawArgs)`.
       2. Every present key (`val !== undefined`) in `REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS[name]` must be a non-empty trimmed `string` (or for `'paths'`, either a non-empty trimmed `string` or a non-empty `Array` of non-empty trimmed `string`s); e.g. `{"AbsolutePath": true, "path": "safe"}` or `{"paths": []}` -> `{ ok: false, reason }`.
       3. Require `extractedPaths.length >= 1` (`0` -> `{ ok: false, reason }`).
       4. Non-path string keys `{ toolaction, toolsummary }` (plus `pattern`/`query` on `search_in_file` and `pageid` on `read_browser_page`) must be `string` when present; any other key is allowed ONLY if `typeof val === 'boolean' || (typeof val === 'number' && Number.isFinite(val))`; any other key with `string`, `Array`, `Object`, `null`, or non-finite number -> `{ ok: false, reason }`.
       5. Return `{ ok: true, paths: extractedPaths.map(toPath) }` and check all extracted paths + `scanPathLike(rawArgs)` against `boosterDataRoots` in `stepOne`.
     - Keep non-required-path `READ_ONLY_TOOLS` (`grep_search`, `code_search`, `file_search`, `find_by_name`, `read_resource`, `search_web`, `list_resources`, `ask_question`, `read_terminal`, `command_status`, `wait`, `wait_5_seconds`) passing when called without path args (preserving `test/pre-tool-use.test.mjs:103-105`), while still checking present path keys and `scanPathLike` against `boosterDataRoots`.

4. `bin/hook-runner.sh`:
   - Add `list_dir|list_permissions|search_in_file|wait|wait_5_seconds` to the fallback `IS_READ_ONLY` `case "$TOOL_NAME"` list, and restrict `manage_task` in fallback `IS_READ_ONLY` so it only passes through if `TMP_FLAT` does NOT contain `kill` or `send_input`.
   - Implement §3.6 `PASSWD_HOME` audit-log enforcement:
     1. Compute `RUNNER_DIR="$(CDPATH='' cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd -P)"` and `RUNNER_ROOT="$(dirname -- "$RUNNER_DIR")"` before log initialization (reusing `LAUNCHER_DIR`/`PLUGIN_ROOT` cleanly).
     2. Resolve `PASSWD_HOME` from OS account database (`getent passwd "$(id -u)" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6`, fallback on macOS `dscl . -read "/Users/$(id -un)" NFSHomeDirectory 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'`).
     3. Staging check: in `case "$RUNNER_ROOT" in */.gemini/config/plugins/*)` unconditionally ignore `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` and `HOME` for log resolution (using `PASSWD_HOME`, falling back to `${RUNNER_ROOT%%/.gemini/*}` verified via `[ -O ... ]` only if `PASSWD_HOME` is empty). Only when `RUNNER_ROOT` is outside `*/.gemini/config/plugins/*` AND `[ -f "$RUNNER_ROOT/test/hook-runner.test.mjs" ]` may non-empty `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` override `PASSWD_HOME` (and if `PASSWD_HOME` is empty in non-staged tests, fall back to `$HOME`). Note: preserve existing `test/hook-runner.test.mjs` behavior when `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` is unset.
     4. Accept `PLUGIN_DATA` env var iff `[ ! -L "$PLUGIN_DATA" ]` and it matches one of the 4 canonical roots under `PASSWD_HOME` (`${PASSWD_HOME}/.gemini/{antigravity-cli,antigravity,antigravity-ide}/plugin_data/antigravity-booster` or `${PASSWD_HOME}/.config/antigravity-booster` with no symlinked parent components); otherwise default `DATA_ROOT` to `${PASSWD_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugin_data/antigravity-booster`.
     5. Set `umask 0077`, `HOOK_LOG_DIR="$DATA_ROOT/logs"`, `HOOK_LOG_FILE="$HOOK_LOG_DIR/hooks.log"`. Detect tampering (`LOG_TAMPERED=1` if `[ -L "$DATA_ROOT" ] || [ -L "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" ] || [ -L "$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ] || ( [ -e "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" ] && [ ! -O "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" ] ) || ( [ -e "$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ] && [ ! -O "$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ] )`): on `LOG_TAMPERED=1`, set `HOOK_LOG_FILE="/dev/null"`, best-effort write `0600` `${PASSWD_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-cli/.agb-hook-log-degraded`, emit `stderr` warning, and in headless workers (`[ -n "$AGB_WORKER_TICKET" ] || [ -n "$AGB_WORKER_MODE" ]`) immediately emit `{"decision":"deny","reason":"agb hook audit log tampered in headless worker"}` and `exit 0`. When NOT tampered, `mkdir -p "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true`, create if absent via `( set -C; : >"$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ) 2>/dev/null || true`, and test `( : >>"$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ) 2>/dev/null`: if read-only/unwritable (e.g. `bwrap` `--ro-bind` `$HOME/.gemini` in `test/hook-runner.test.mjs:689-707`), set `LOG_DEGRADED=1` (NOT `LOG_TAMPERED`), `HOOK_LOG_FILE="/dev/null"`, best-effort write `.agb-hook-log-degraded` if writable, append ` [audit-log-degraded]` on fallback JSON `reason`s in `emit_fallback`, and allow normal child policy evaluation to proceed so `test/hook-runner.test.mjs:689-707` stays 100% green!
     6. Verify `shellcheck -s sh bin/node-launcher.sh bin/hook-runner.sh` passes with 0 warnings.

5. Build & Tests:
   - Run `npm run build` so `dist/**` is updated.
   - Add comprehensive tests in `test/policy-1-5-9-readonly.test.mjs` and `test/hook-runner.test.mjs` covering: all 10 `REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS` tools across all 5 context columns, non-ASCII `ſ`/`K` & case-duplicate rejection, `{"AbsolutePath": true, "path": "safe"}` type confusion denial, all 4 `boosterDataRoots` / `PLUGIN_DATA` canonical roots + rogue `PLUGIN_DATA` rejection, staged `<tmp>/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-booster/bin/hook-runner.sh` ignoring `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME`, and symlinked `HOOK_LOG_DIR`/`HOOK_LOG_FILE` denying headless workers.
   - Acceptance: `shellcheck -s sh bin/node-launcher.sh bin/hook-runner.sh && npm run build && npm test && npm run plugin:validate` exit 0.

edges.contract: T1 exports goFoldKey(k), normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(args), and extractReadToolPaths(name, args) from hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs, exports REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS and promotes list_dir/list_permissions/search_in_file/wait/wait_5_seconds in hooks/policy/constants.mjs, and expands boosterDataRoots(home) to all 4 plugin-data roots in hooks/policy/paths.mjs. T2 reuses normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive and evaluateFileTool without editing test/policy-1-5-9-readonly.test.mjs or test/hook-runner.test.mjs.

title: Harden PreToolUse read-only schemas, Go fold.go key parity, and PASSWD_HOME audit logging
